newsitem.title: INDIA: Cyclone near India's Gujarat state peters out.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone near India's Gujarat state peters out.

text.p: Indian weather forecasters said on Friday a cyclone moving across the Arabian Sea and expected to strike India's western state of Gujarat late in the afternoon had blown itself out as it moved closer to the coast.
"The cyclone has rapidly turned into a depression heading north," an official with the Bombay weather bureau told Reuters.

The depression, an area of low pressure, was 50 kms off the Gujarat coast, the official said. It would cross the coast early on Saturday morning, bringing heavy rain and winds of about 50 kmph to 60 kmph, she added.
The cyclone was originally forecast to hit the coast on Thursday night but then slowed as it passed over the Arabian Sea, the weather official said.
It would also bring some rain to Bombay, in neighbouring Maharashtra state, the weather official said.
